# fw align

> Reference of the fw align command: DPO, ORPO and KTO loss demo on one synthetic preference pair; no model is aligned. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/align/

DPO, ORPO and KTO loss demo on one synthetic preference pair; no model is aligned

## Usage

```bash
fw align <dpo|orpo|kto> [--beta 0.1] [--steps 60]
```

## Aliases

`fw dpo` runs `fw align`. `fw orpo` runs `fw align`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw align dpo
fw align orpo
fw align kto
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--beta` | `0.1` |
| `--steps` | `60` |

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
